name: Remote MCP Server on Cloudflare (Without Auth)
description: A template for deploying MCP servers to Cloudflare Workers without authentication. Enables quick deployment of custom MCP tools that can be accessed from Claude Desktop or the Cloudflare AI Playground via server-sent events.
